mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a bedroom and bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical ground-up bedroom-and-bathroom addition usually takes between three and six months to complete once physical construction begins. The overall timeline depends on architectural drafting, permitting reviews, site foundation preparation, framing, plumbing rough-ins, drywall installation, and final fixture finishes. Weather delays, municipal inspection schedules, and special-order items like custom vanities or tile can also impact the schedule. Because adding plumbing requires tying into your existing sewer or septic lines and water mains, coordinating sub-trade inspections before closing up drywall is critical to keeping the project moving forward smoothly without delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most bedroom-and-bathroom additions take three to six months to construct once permits are issued, depending on site conditions, inspection schedules, and custom finish selections.
